rate_units: g/h per operating mode, age-weighted with input_vehicle_type.csv percentages
rate_completeness: 31 ages x 23 op-modes, no missing values, all rates positive
moves_version_and_settings: not recorded in the delivery (to be confirmed)
smoothing: equal-weight 11-sample centred moving average at 10 Hz (one second)
acceleration: centred one-second difference of the smoothed speed
boundaries: principal comparison pads both paths with v1 before and v2 after the window
integration: left-endpoint 0.1 s intervals over [t1, t2); sum of dt equals T
braking: a <= -2 mph/s, or a < -1 mph/s at t, t-1 s, t-2 s; classified before idle/running
vsp_bins: 1 kW/t bins i = -20..20 as [i-0.5, i+0.5), plus below/above bins
